scope: same 20 fixed v0.2 geometries; independent fresh count vectors; flat 3+1, fixed external labels and known density
primary_gate: At the 16x information budget, all 20 geometries must have one-sided Clopper-Pearson certificate-availability lower bound >=0.90, Bonferroni alpha=0.05/20. Lower budgets are descriptive comparisons.
confidence_region: Unchanged v0.3 likelihood region sum D(y_i||lambda_i)<=48, noncoverage <=2^30 exp(-24). No repeated-look or simultaneous-observation claim.
improvements: exact square-root remainder with positive count lower envelope
4x4 PSD matrices bounding matrix-valued and vector-valued linear fluctuations; minimum of trace, Frobenius and row-sum upper bounds
comparison: v0.3 method on the identical fresh counts; every positive candidate of either method validated at 60 decimal digits
candidate_policy: Float scan followed by outward interval validation; failed guards and rejected candidates retained as HOLD. No geometry or true parameters passed to either certifier.
audit: Independent exact seed replay; exact certificate inequalities and known-target evaluation; independent interval point solve; first/last new certificate in each nonempty cell repeated at 90 digits; 256 random ellipsoid-boundary directions for each selected certificate; archived region witnesses checked exactly.
development_data: Published v0.3 observations used to diagnose and design the bound. They are not fresh validation.
no_claims: physical realizability of unrestricted-mean region witnesses
closing the original-budget gate by raising the budget
